create_block: create a Block instance from values and placement for internal pandas data structure management
build_extension_block: build an ExtensionBlock to hold 3rd-party extension array types in pandas internals
build_numpy_block: build a NumpyBlock for holding numpy ndarray values with numeric or object dtype
test_block_replace: test the Block.replace method to replace values matching a to_replace pattern with a new value
test_block_fillna: test the Block.fillna method to fill missing values with a specified value and optional limit
test_block_setitem: test the Block.setitem method to set values at a given indexer possibly creating a new array
refactor_block_coerce: refactor the Block.coerce_to_target_dtype method to coerce block values to a compatible dtype
review_block_putmask: review the Block.putmask method to apply a boolean mask and replace values returning resulting blocks
summarize_block_quantile: summarize the Block.quantile method to compute quantiles of block values with specified interpolation
